title: Completed REQUIREMENTS TRACEABILITY MATRIX Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed REQUIREMENTS TRACEABILITY MATRIX artifact data payloads (PMO-04.02.04).

traceability_purpose_and_baseline_refere.description: The governing objective and versioned requirements baseline linked across the matrix.

traceability_dimensions_and_attributes.description: Key parameters tracked including source origin, WBS work package, design component, and test case ID.

business_need_to_requirement_linkage.description: Explicit linkage connecting overarching business goals to detailed functional requirements.

requirement_to_wbs_deliverable_mapping.description: Traceability mapping associating each requirement with its corresponding WBS work package.

requirement_to_design_and_test_case_mapp.description: Verification mapping linking requirements to technical architecture components and test verification cases.

core_inter_requirement_dependencies.description: Identified functional linkages, prerequisite requirements, and cross-feature constraints.

impact_and_traceability_governance.description: Protocols for assessing downstream deliverable impact when a linked requirement is modified.
